A division of [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]], '''Baktoid Fleet Ordnance''' was responsible for the production of large, droid-equipped warships for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platform droid gunship]] was developed and manufactured by Baktoid Fleet Ordnance.
